apps/web/src/analytics.ts: The session counted once, so a reload does not count it again: a counter's memory, no view choice.
apps/web/src/app/local-storage-file-syst: The host's own files in a browser tab: data the host keeps, no view choice.
apps/web/src/app/web-host.ts: That a sign-in left the tab for the provider, kept for its session so the page it comes back to counts it once: a counter's memory, no view choice.
apps/web/src/connect-return.ts: The connect flow's handoff on its return: credential handling, kept for the tab's life.
packages/panel/src/composer-drafts.ts: The words a person had typed and not sent: a draft, never a view choice.
packages/panel/src/desktop/failed-runs.t: Which automation failure was last seen on this Mac: a read mark, not a view choice.
packages/panel/src/desktop/section-icon-: The section icons last chosen on this Mac, offered first as Recent: a history of picks, no view choice.
packages/panel/src/last-sign-in.ts: The provider last signed in with, offered first at the next sign-in: credential handling.
packages/panel/src/settings/agent-auth-s: Whether the first sign-in's notice was seen, which a refused read counts as seen: a notice's memory, no view choice.
packages/panel/src/tasks/terminal-held.t: The shells this window opened on the Mac, by id and name, kept for its session so a reload attaches to them again: data main holds, no view choice.
packages/panel/src/update-toast.ts: The version whose update the toast last announced: a notice's memory, no view choice.
